programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: After several years of efforts, Martyna receives permission to come to China.He visits the Shaolin Valley area, where the influence of the traditional, strict upbringing of the Chinese is most clearly visible.Currently, over 5,000 students study at the school, which originates from a legendary Buddhist monastery.He teaches them, among others:Liu Yin Ping, a fifth-degree kung fu master.She is the only woman who lives on the school premises with her husband, the vice-champion of martial arts in all of China.The woman has a five-year-old son, but she also has to be a mother to her children, the youngest of whom are five years old.Students start their day at 5:40 a.m., and at 6:00 a.m. they have their first martial arts training.They spend all their time at school and visit their parents only once a year.They believe they can achieve any goal, they just have to work hard enough.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Every year, surrogate mothers in India give birth to approximately 25,000 babies.Nearly half of this number are 'orders' from Western couples.In Annand, Martyna meets Dr. Nyana Patel, who runs a fertility clinic and a surrogacy home.About eighty pregnant women are under her care.They are usually young and often illiterate girls from small towns, who thus earn the equivalent of ten years' income in just 9 months.The demand for their services is huge.The Polish traveler learns the stories of women who decided to rent their bodies to give birth to children to other people.He meets Manisia, who has three children of her own, and a married couple who, thanks to Dr. Patel and one of the surrogates, have the desired offspring.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: In Thailand, any teenager can legally buy and use hormones that will enable him to change his gender if he feels the need.Operations changing men into women and vice versa are also carried out on a massive scale in the country.Martyna meets a doctor who runs the oldest clinic in Bangkok offering this type of services, and assists him during the procedure.The traveler also meets his patients and looks behind the scenes of the selection of the most beautiful ladyboys in Thailand.He also meets a talented dancer, Lukpad, whom he accompanies in his everyday life and during preparations for the show in which she appears.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places There is a place in downtown Los Angeles that tourists and locals alike stay away from.Tens of thousands of people who have become homeless camp every day in the Skid Row district.Pastor Troy runs a center that helps people in crisis of homelessness get back on their feet.Marcin learns the story of a priest who also struggled with a serious life crisis and now devotes all his energy to supporting others.The leader continues his journey to Slab City, a settlement located on the site of a former military base inhabited by those who want to live on their own terms.

programme.title: Africa Express
programme.desc: For the first time, the race will take participants through Africa.They will cover the route through Kenya and Tanzania - from the foot of Kilimanjaro, through the crowded streets of Arusha, to the sand dunes by the Indian Ocean and historic Mombasa, ending the competition in Nairobi.Eight couples: Ewa Gawryluk-Domaniecka with her husband Piotr Domaniecki, Edyta Zając with her partner Michał Mikołajczak, Nikodem Rozbicki with her friend Paweł Kurkowski, Wiktoria Gąsiewska with her brother Mateusz Gąsiewski, Tomasz Iwan with her partner Karolina Woźniak, Katarzyna Niezgoda with her husband Paweł Markiewicz, Izu Ugonoh with his wife Antonina Ugonoh and MonikaHoffman-Piszora, together with her sister Iga Hoffman, faces the challenges of harsh, unpredictable nature - lack of roads, difficult access to water and communication, time pressure and their own emotions.The program will be hosted by Iza Krzan.Every day, participants must demonstrate perseverance, cooperation and resilience, learning about completely different faces of Africa.It's a test of boundaries and a lesson in friendship Participants move from the lands of Tsavo to the majestic Great Rift Valley, where the expedition gains new dynamics.The couple who left the race are given a chance to return, but must remain hidden, traveling without luggage or support.If exposed, they will face elimination.The others face the task of estimating the length of the longest continental trench, fighting for the advantage on the further route to Naivasha, the center of the Kenyan flower industry.There, couples prepare symbolic bouquets to order, testing their floral talents.Fighting for the amulet is Kati's dynamic game, reminiscent of dodgeball.In Nairobi, competitors immerse themselves in the world of colorful matatu minibuses.They must find their driver, learn to dance and engage passengers in having fun together.The finale reveals the secret of the return of the eliminated couple.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: In Bulgaria, Martyna visits a traditional family belonging to the small Kalajj ethnic group.Only 18,000 of them live in the country.The Kalajjs care very much about the purity of the group, and they arrange marriages only between their own kin.The young people get to know each other and observe each other for years, and if a bachelor catches the eye of a girl, negotiations begin.Every year, everyone comes to the area of ​​Stara Zagora on Saint Theodore's Day.Martyna meets 19-year-old Vasylka.The girl will present herself at this year's virgin market.The traveler accompanies her in preparations, during which they choose a dress and bake a traditional cake.He also learns about the amazing customs of the Kalajj people, their financial negotiations and the type of test that is supposed to prove that the bride has actually remained chaste until her wedding night.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: The World Health Organization estimates that there are approximately 170,000 people with vitiligo in Tanzania.Albinos are very susceptible to burns and skin cancer.Many of them die before the age of 40.The threat is not only from the harsh African sun, but also from other people.In Tanzania, it is common to believe that the body of an albino has magical powers.Hunting of them is becoming more and more common.Martyna visits a school where a hundred children suffering from vitiligo study.He also meets 19-year-old Kabula.A girl aged 12 was brutally attacked.After the incident, she is determined to become a lawyer and defend the rights of people affected by albinism in the future.Together with Martyna, they will visit her parents, whom she has not seen for 5 years.Previously, the girl did not have the courage to come home.
